fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects potential suspicious run-only executions compiled using OSACompile
fields.name: OSACompile Run-Only Execution
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="osx" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "osacompile" and tgt.process.cmdline contains " -x " and tgt.process.cmdline contains " -e "))
